name: pagelingo
description: Shared translation SDK and applications for technical reading.

scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/translation-core && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/assistant-core
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspace @pagelingo/translation-core
scripts.test:extension: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.test:watch: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:watch --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:e2e --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:package && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pdf:lint: uv run --directory services/document-parser --locked --no-sync ruff check src tests
